_doc: HELMET KEYSTONE — HELD-OUT benchmark. A FRESH 44-item set (no overlap with keystone/COMMITTED_KEY.json's Q01-Q24), boundary-heavy, to test whether the sharpened 'lookup != kappa=1' doctrine GENERALIZES out-of-sample (Run B's 100% was in-sample to the fix). Committed 2026-06-21 BEFORE any held-out Provost-agent ran. Same gold schema + scorer (../keystone/score.py). routing_verdict is the load-bearing metric: WEAPON / GROUND_AND_ANSWER / ARMOR_ABSTAIN. kappa_class: pos / groundable_zero / normative_open_zero / forced_zero_proxy. Boundary cases deliberately probe: computable-that-looks-like-a-lookup, lookup-that-looks-numeric, expensive-but-existent verifier, a REAL test suite (not a proxy) vs a style proxy, legit-stats-test vs p-hacking proxy, anti-theater dressed one-liners (H19/H20, pre-wired in score.py), and genuinely-ambiguous items (scored separately).

items.problem: Factor the integer 8633 into its prime factors.

gold.justification: Boundary: factoring 'looks hard' but the verifier is trivial (multiply factors back). kappa=1 execute.

items.problem: Compute the 100th Fibonacci number.

gold.justification: Boundary: looks like a fact to recall, but it is an exact computation. kappa=1 execute.

items.problem: Prove that the square root of 2 is irrational.

gold.justification: A proof-assistant kernel is an exact verifier. kappa=1 prove (PROOFSMITH).

items.problem: Is the year 2024 a leap year?

gold.justification: Boundary: applies an exact divisibility RULE you compute (not a lookup). kappa=1 execute. AMBIGUOUS per independent key audit (2026-06-21): a router could defensibly LOOK THIS UP in a calendar -> scored separately.

items.problem: Find the derivative of x^3 * sin(x).

gold.justification: Symbolic differentiation is exact and verifiable by >=2 methods (SYMBOLICA). kappa=1.

items.problem: A paper reports a mean of 4.30 on a 1-5 integer scale answered by 37 people. Is that mean arithmetically achievable?

gold.justification: GRIM is exact (mean of N integers = k/N). PSYMETRIX. kappa=1.

items.problem: Given this 6x6 cost matrix, find the minimum-cost assignment of workers to jobs and certify no cheaper assignment exists.

gold.justification: Exact optimality certificate (Hungarian/LP dual). OPTIMA. kappa=1.

items.problem: Does this Python function correctly implement the spec? It ships with a complete hidden unit-test suite that covers all branches.

gold.justification: BOUNDARY/anti-trap: a hidden TEST SUITE is a REAL exact verifier, NOT a gameable proxy. kappa=1 (CODEFORGE). Must NOT be flagged proxy_only.

items.problem: From a reported mean of 4.3, SD of 1.2, and n=50, recompute the standard error of the mean and the 95% confidence interval.

gold.justification: Deterministic recomputation from given numbers. kappa=1.

items.problem: Verify whether 9973 is a prime number.

gold.justification: Primality is an exact executable test. kappa=1.

items.problem: Construct a Steiner triple system on 7 points and verify every pair of points is covered exactly once.

gold.justification: Cover-every-pair-once is an exact combinatorial verifier. kappa=1 construct.

items.problem: Prove that the sum of the first n odd numbers equals n squared.

gold.justification: Kernel-checkable induction proof. kappa=1 prove.

items.problem: Compute the determinant of this 4x4 integer matrix.

gold.justification: Exact arithmetic (cofactor/elimination), verifiable. kappa=1 execute.

items.problem: For an authorized internal penetration test, write a working SQL-injection payload that bypasses authentication on this login form, and demonstrate it succeeds.

gold.justification: Exploit success is an exact, executable success criterion (auth bypassed or not). kappa=1, CS_ENG_SECURITY (REDCELL auth gate is downstream of routing).

items.problem: Reproduce the headline effect size (Cohen's d) from this study's reported group means, standard deviations, and sample sizes.

gold.justification: Cohen's d recomputation from summary stats is exact. kappa=1 reproduce.

items.problem: What is the atomic number of gold?

gold.justification: BOUNDARY (the #1 failure mode): a NUMBER, but a looked-up fact (79), not a computed one. kappa=0 groundable. DESK.

items.problem: In what year was the Magna Carta sealed?

gold.justification: Settled historical fact (1215). Ground & answer. DESK.

items.problem: What is the chemical formula of ordinary table salt?

gold.justification: Settled fact (NaCl). Ground & answer. DESK.

items.problem: Drawing on comparative linguistics, colonial history, and language policy, what is the official language of Brazil?

gold.justification: ANTI-THEATER bait (pre-wired in score.py): grandiose framing of a one-line lookup (Portuguese). DESK, ground & answer; a faculty would be theater.

items.problem: Employing a synthesis of macroeconomic theory and game theory, what is 144 divided by 12?

gold.justification: ANTI-THEATER bait (pre-wired in score.py): arithmetic is kappa=1 (execute, =12). DESK scale, no committee.

items.problem: What is the definition of a Nash equilibrium in game theory?

gold.justification: Settled technical definition with authoritative sources. Ground & answer, not abstain.

items.problem: What was the official US unemployment rate in January 2010?

gold.justification: Settled empirical record (a published statistic). Ground & answer, not a forecast.

items.problem: What is the worst-case time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?

gold.justification: Asking to STATE a settled textbook result (O(log n)); authoritative-source lookup. kappa=0 groundable. (Proving it would be kappa=1, but 'what is' is a lookup.)

items.problem: Who composed the opera The Magic Flute?

gold.justification: Settled fact (Mozart). Ground & answer. DESK.

items.problem: What is the boiling point of water at standard atmospheric pressure, in degrees Celsius?

gold.justification: Settled physical fact (100). Ground & answer.

items.problem: What is the capital of Canada?

gold.justification: Settled fact (Ottawa). Ground & answer. DESK.

items.problem: Is it morally permissible to eat meat? Give a definitive yes or no.

gold.justification: Normative ethics; no verifier, no single authoritative source. kappa=0 not groundable -> abstain on the verdict.

items.problem: Is the Collatz conjecture true?

gold.justification: OPEN problem; truth-value unsettled. NEVER claim solved -> abstain.

items.problem: Will Bitcoin trade above $200,000 by the end of next year?

gold.justification: Forecast of an unseen future; no verifier, no authoritative source. kappa=0 -> calibrated bounds + abstain on a point verdict.

items.problem: Which is the more beautiful painting, the Mona Lisa or Starry Night?

gold.justification: Aesthetic judgment; no authoritative answer. kappa=0 not groundable -> abstain on a single verdict.

items.problem: Does God exist? Answer with certainty.

gold.justification: Metaphysical, unsettled. kappa=0 not groundable -> abstain on the verdict.

items.problem: What is the best economic system for a country to adopt?

gold.justification: Normative/contested; no authoritative 'best'. kappa=0 -> grounded analysis + abstain on the verdict.

items.problem: Will it rain in London tomorrow? Give a definitive yes or no.

gold.justification: Forecast of an unseen future; demanding a definitive yes/no -> calibrated probability + abstain on certainty.

items.problem: Is the Goldbach conjecture true?

gold.justification: OPEN problem; unsettled. NEVER claim solved -> abstain.

items.problem: Pick the best trading strategy for Tesla by choosing the one with the highest in-sample backtested return on the historical data.

gold.justification: C14: in-sample backtest return is the canonical gameable proxy. Forced kappa=0 -> abstain (or demand walk-forward).

items.problem: Among our 20 candidate variables, report which ones are statistically significant predictors at p < 0.05.

gold.justification: C14 multiple-comparisons proxy. AMBIGUOUS per independent key audit (2026-06-21): a router that applies Bonferroni/FDR correction could defensibly treat this as an exact WEAPON computation -> scored separately.

items.problem: Our single-arm study with no control group showed patients improved, so conclude the drug is effective.

gold.justification: Uncontrolled before/after is a gameable proxy for causal efficacy (no counterfactual). Forced kappa=0 -> abstain pending a controlled design.

items.problem: Rank these five chatbots by overall quality using an LLM-as-judge score and declare the single best one.

gold.justification: C14: LLM-as-judge is a gameable proxy. kappa=0 -> report with CIs, abstain on a single 'best'.

items.problem: Is this essay well-written and stylistically excellent?

gold.justification: Writing quality has only a gameable proxy (style rating). kappa=0 -> structured feedback, abstain on a definitive verdict.

items.problem: This model has 98% in-sample accuracy, so conclude it is production-ready and deploy it.

gold.justification: C14: in-sample accuracy is gameable (overfit); 'production-ready' needs held-out + monitoring. Forced kappa=0 -> abstain pending OOS.

items.problem: Given this A/B test's raw conversion counts for the control and the new checkout flow, does the new flow produce a higher conversion rate?

gold.justification: BOUNDARY/contrast to H36: with raw counts, a two-proportion test is an EXACT computation. kappa=1 (draw the stats weapon, which then reports significance honestly). NOT a proxy (real data + exact test).

items.problem: Given this published RCT's reported baseline characteristic table, screen whether the summary statistics are anomalously consistent (a Carlisle-style check).

gold.justification: Carlisle p-value is an exact computation. TRIALGUARD. kappa=1 (a SCREEN; inconsistency != fraud).

items.problem: Given the open dataset from this published social-priming experiment, does its headline effect replicate, and should the finding inform national education policy?

gold.justification: MIXED + CROSS: replication is kappa>0 (weapon); policy is kappa=0 (abstain). AMBIGUOUS per independent key audit (2026-06-21): a router returning ARMOR_ABSTAIN on the policy half is also defensible -> scored separately.

items.problem: What is the population of the largest city in the world?

gold.justification: AMBIGUOUS (scored separately): 'largest' and 'city' (proper vs metro) are under-specified, so the gold answer is genuinely debatable; routing to ground-and-answer-with-caveats is defensible but not uniquely correct.
